classification.rationale: Selected domain=wet_lab_molecular from 3 matched signals because specialist evidence remained at least half of the general-method fallback score; selected logic_mode=methodological from 4 matched signals because its profile had the strongest signal coverage.

focus_prompt:
Treat this as a wet-lab molecular or cellular biology paper. Extract the experimental system, species, tissue, cell line, sample preparation, controls, reagents, perturbations, dose, duration, temperature, selection timeline, and assay readouts with their units. Preserve biological and technical replicate counts, sample sizes, statistical tests, and the exact conditions under which each result was observed. Distinguish measured results from mechanistic interpretation, and do not manufacture missing protocol details.

Treat this as a methodological comparison or method-evolution argument. Extract the proposed method and each baseline separately while preserving the shared task, datasets and splits, assumptions, preprocessing, training and evaluation protocol, hyperparameters, ablations, and implementation requirements. Capture every performance metric with direction, unit, uncertainty, and evaluation context, including runtime, memory, sample efficiency, or resource cost when reported. Map metrics to ResultObservation, and baselines or assumptions to experiment/task or method protocol descriptions; do not create undeclared output fields.
